title: Google Swaps Gemini 2.5 Pro For 3.8 Flash On Dec 1
description:
Gemini 2.5 Pro API requests auto-route to Gemini 3.8 Flash on Dec 1, 2026, billed at Flash rates: $0.75 in / $3.75 out per 1M tokens through Dec 31, then $1.50 / $7.50 from Jan 1. 2.5 Pro was $1.25 / $10. Source: aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing
